metadata.description: BMAD skills, modules, and agents hosted in this monorepo at docs/foundry/marketplace/.

plugins.name: mason-environment
plugins.description: Resolve a teammate project's conda and pip manifests into one lockfile, then check that lockfile. No pixi environment name.

plugins.name: mason-package
plugins.description: Build a wheel and sdist from the project directory. Upload stays behind an explicit confirm. No pixi environment name.

plugins.name: warden-scan
plugins.description: Run the warden scan gate on the current project. Engine probes are not a second verdict. No pixi environment name.
